_comment_hosts: NOTHING here names a station. radio_port empty = use the simulated rig. tgxl_host/kmtronic_host empty = that feature is off. Fill them in on the machine, never in the repo.
_comment_watchdog: 0 disables the transmit watchdog. Negative is refused - it is a typo, and treating it as disabled would remove the only thing stopping a stuck PTT.
_comment_users: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. A placeholder entry here with a blank password_hash makes the host refuse to start - it is not a template to fill in, it is an invalid user. Run 'sudo hamdeck-host-password' to create the admin credential; it goes in /etc/hamdeck-cpp/env, never in this file. Extra users are added from the admin page once you can log in. Format, if you ever hand-write one: pbkdf2:<hex salt>:<hex hash>, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 350000 iterations.
